notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can deal at least six combat damage that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Attack with the creatures to deal at least six combat damage to a player, triggering Old Gnawbone's ability, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Before the end of your combat phase, activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, to add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to untap all creatures you control, give them trample, lifelink, and haste and to get an additional combat phase and an additional main phase after that.
End the combat phase.
Repeat.
